full_judgment: 7. Mr Santi Ranjan Karmaker, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners, submits that the learned Court of appeal below erred in law in reversing the judgment and order passed by the learned trial Court without properly adverting to the reasons assigned by it. The learned Advocate further submits that the learned Court of appeal below erred in law in deciding the question of limitation in a casual manner without properly discussing and considering the evidence on this point and the same has resulted in error in the impugned decision occasioning failure of justice. Mr Karmaker further submits that the learned appellate Court also erred in law in holding that the suit is bad for misjoinder of parties as well as for misjoinder of causes of action and the same has occasioned failure of justice.
